requirements.statement: A merchant can sign in securely to a self-service portal that shows only their own data

criteria.must: A merchant can sign in through the portal's SSO flow
A signed-in merchant sees only their own account's data, never another merchant's

requirements.statement: A merchant can see all payments their customers made over mobile money and card

criteria.must: The transactions list shows collections made via mobile money
The transactions list shows collections made via card

requirements.statement: A merchant can see a double-entry ledger view showing gross collections, fees deducted, and net payable

criteria.must: The ledger view lists individual debit and credit entries
The ledger view lets the merchant trace how a settlement's net amount was calculated from gross collections minus fees

requirements.statement: A merchant can see the date and amount of their next scheduled settlement

criteria.must: The portal displays the next scheduled settlement's date
The portal displays the next scheduled settlement's expected amount

requirements.statement: A merchant can see a history of past settlements paid to them

criteria.must: The settlement history lists past settlements with their paid amounts and dates

requirements.statement: A merchant is notified when a settlement has been paid out to them

criteria.must: An in-app notification appears once a settlement is paid

requirements.statement: A merchant can view the details of an individual transaction

criteria.must: The transaction detail view shows channel, amount, timestamp and status

requirements.statement: Collections made via mobile money and via card are aggregated into a single settlement per cycle

criteria.must: A settlement covering a period with both mobile money and card collections produces one consolidated payout, not one per channel

requirements.statement: New collections stop being settled to a merchant whose trading status is not active

criteria.must: A merchant whose trading status is inactive has their settlement withheld rather than paid

requirements.statement: A merchant's settlements are paid to the payout account on file with the merchant identity system

criteria.must: A paid settlement's payout is routed to the payout account held by the merchant identity system, not to a value entered in this product

requirements.statement: The platform operates in Kenya (KES) and Nigeria (NGN) with no cross-currency conversion for a single merchant

criteria.must: A merchant's collections, ledger and settlements are all shown in a single currency matching their operating country

requirements.statement: Settlement runs on a single, fixed, platform-wide cadence with no operations/back-office console

criteria.must: All merchants share the same settlement cadence rather than individually configured schedules
